products.name: Oncology Liquid Biopsy and Detection Solutions
products.description: A suite of integrated devices and consumables for the detection, enrichment, identification, and counting of circulating tumor cells (CTCs) and related tumor markers from blood samples. This includes automated sample preparation (A+Pre), rare cell enrichment (AC-1000), single cell capture (A+SCDrop), automated immunofluorescence staining and analysis (A+CellScan), and supporting microfluidic chips. These are physical devices and consumables manufactured using semiconductor and microfluidic technologies, requiring regulatory approval as medical devices.

products.name: Immunostaining Kits for Tumor Cell Identification
products.description: A set of immunochromogenic reagent kits (A+CTCE, A+CTCM, A+EMT, A+CM) designed for multiplexed fluorescent staining and identification of specific tumor cell types and tumor-associated macrophages in enriched blood samples. These are biochemical reagent kits used in conjunction with detection devices and require regulatory approval as IVD products.

products.name: Lung Cancer Early Screening Kit (A+LCGuard)
products.description: A specialized in vitro diagnostic kit for early screening of lung cancer, used to assist in the determination of benign and malignant pulmonary nodules by detecting CTCs and tumor markers in blood samples. This is a regulated Class III medical device requiring clinical trials and regulatory approval.

products.name: 3D Cell Culture Platform (A+PerfusC™ System)
products.description: A compact, automated perfusion-based 3D cell culture incubator system for in vitro formation of tumor spheroids and organoids, supporting long-term, hands-free culture for drug screening and disease modeling. This is a physical laboratory instrument with consumable culture plates, designed for research and pharmaceutical applications.

products.name: OEM and Custom Microfluidic Chip Production Services
products.description: Contract manufacturing and custom design services for microfluidic chips, biochips, micro-electromechanical components, and sensors for third-party customers, leveraging the company's proprietary micro-nano manufacturing technology platform. These are physical components produced to customer specifications for use in biomedical and other applications.

products.name: nCino Platform (Intelligent Banking Platform)
products.description: A unified, cloud-based platform delivering intelligent automation, workflow digitization, and embedded AI for financial institutions, supporting mission-critical banking operations across multiple business lines. Delivered as a SaaS solution built on Salesforce and AWS infrastructure, it integrates data, analytics, and AI to optimize operations, risk management, and customer experiences.

products.name: Onboarding Solutions
products.description: Digital onboarding solutions for financial institutions, streamlining customer onboarding, account opening, and compliance processes through automation, centralized data, and intelligent document management. Delivered via the nCino Platform as a configurable SaaS module.

products.name: Account Opening Solutions
products.description: Digital account opening solutions for consumers and small businesses, enabling multi-channel, rapid account creation with automated identity verification, compliance tools, and integrated digital customer service. Delivered as a SaaS module within the nCino Platform.

products.name: Lending Solutions (Commercial, Consumer, Small Business, Mortgage)
products.description: Comprehensive loan origination solutions for commercial, consumer, small business, and mortgage lending, automating the entire loan lifecycle, credit decisioning, and compliance. Delivered as configurable SaaS modules within the nCino Platform, integrating workflow automation and AI-driven analytics.

products.name: Credit Monitoring and Portfolio Analytics
products.description: Credit monitoring and portfolio analytics solutions that centralize data, automate workflows, and provide real-time risk analysis, compliance monitoring, and profitability optimization for financial institutions. Delivered as SaaS modules within the nCino Platform, leveraging advanced analytics and AI.

products.name: Integration and Intelligence Solutions (AI, Data, iPaaS)
products.description: Integration and intelligence solutions including embedded artificial intelligence (generative, predictive, agentic), analytics, and an integration platform as a service (iPaaS) to connect core banking systems, fintech applications, and third-party services. Delivered as part of the nCino Platform to enable actionable insights and workflow automation.

products.name: Salesforce CRM Resale for Financial Institutions
products.description: Authorized resale of Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) solution functionality to certain financial institutions in the U.S., bundled with nCino solutions and delivered as a subscription service.

products.name: First Defense® Calf Scours Prevention Products
products.description: Orally delivered, pathogen-specific antibody products derived from hyperimmunized bovine colostrum, manufactured using proprietary vaccination and milk protein purification technologies, and administered to newborn calves in bolus, gel, or powder formats to prevent neonatal calf diarrhea (scours).

products.name: First Defense Technology® Functional Feed Ingredients
products.description: Bulk powder feed ingredients derived from hyperimmune colostrum, designed for incorporation into liquid feeding programs for batch mixing in large calf-rearing operations, regulated as feed supplements by the FDA.

products.name: California Mastitis Test (CMT)
products.description: A quick on-farm diagnostic test used to determine which quarter of a cow's udder is mastitic, sold as a tool for dairy producers.

products.name: Texas Roadhouse Restaurants
products.description: Moderately priced, full-service, casual dining restaurants offering hand-cut steaks, ribs, seafood, chicken, pork, burgers, salads, sandwiches, and made-from-scratch sides, prepared and served in a southwestern-themed atmosphere. Food is prepared fresh daily and served with attentive in-person service.

products.name: Bubba’s 33 Restaurants
products.description: Moderately priced, full-service, casual dining restaurants featuring scratch-made burgers, pizza, wings, appetizers, sandwiches, dinner entrées, and a full bar with beer and cocktails, served in a sports and music-themed environment. Food is prepared fresh and served both in-person and via delivery.

products.name: Jaggers Restaurants
products.description: Fast-casual restaurants offering burgers, hand-breaded chicken sandwiches and tenders, made-to-order salads, and hand-spun milkshakes, with drive-thru, carry-out, dine-in, and delivery options. Food is prepared fresh and served quickly in a modern setting.

products.name: Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Franchise sales and support for Texas Roadhouse and Jaggers restaurant concepts, including area development and franchise agreements for domestic and international locations. Franchisees operate under company standards and pay fees and royalties.

products.name: Branded Retail Food and Accessories
products.description: Branded food and accessory products, such as frozen rolls, whipped buttery spreads, beef jerky, steak sauces, seasonings, and bagged peanuts, sold online, in select retailers, and in stadiums. These products are produced through licensing and direct sales arrangements.

products.name: Gaming Terminals and Content
products.description: Digital gaming terminals and associated software/content, including slots, casino games, and electronic table games, supplied to licensed betting offices, casinos, gaming halls, and adult gaming centers. Delivered via proprietary server-based gaming (SBG) technology and participation-based or outright sales models.

products.name: Virtual Sports Products
products.description: Software and networking solutions providing fixed-odds wagering on ultra-high definition, computer-rendered simulations of sporting events (e.g., soccer, football, basketball, racing) for betting shops, online, and mobile platforms. Delivered as turnkey or integrated solutions under recurring participation-based contracts.

products.name: Interactive iGaming Content
products.description: Development and distribution of interactive-only casino games (slots, table games, hybrid dealer games) hosted on remote gaming servers for online and mobile gaming operators. Content is delivered digitally via integrations with operator and aggregator platforms worldwide.

products.name: Leisure Gaming and Amusement Machines
products.description: Supply and operation of gaming terminals and amusement machines to the leisure and hospitality sectors (pubs, bingo halls, motorway service areas), including content and machine supply under participation-based or fixed-fee contracts. Focus is on server-based terminals and content distribution.

products.name: Augmented and Virtual Reality Educational Platform
products.description: A proprietary hardware and software platform delivering interactive, stereoscopic 3D learning experiences for K-12 and Career & Technical Education (CTE) markets, without the need for VR goggles or specialty glasses. The platform includes custom laptops, tracked styluses, and a suite of educational applications, and is delivered through direct sales and resellers.

products.name: Inspire and Imagine Laptops
products.description: Custom-built laptops featuring autostereoscopic 3D graphics and eye-tracking technology, enabling immersive AR/VR educational experiences without eyewear, delivered with a patented hand-held stylus. Inspire targets general and advanced users, while Imagine is designed for elementary students with a smaller, lighter form factor.

products.name: Tracked Styluses
products.description: Patented hand-held styluses that work with the company's laptops to allow users to interact with 3D projections, providing precise, haptic-enabled manipulation of virtual objects for educational purposes. Manufactured by a third-party partner to proprietary specifications.

products.name: Educational Software Applications
products.description: A library of proprietary and third-party developed software applications for STEM and CTE education, including modules for science, health, math, automotive, advanced manufacturing, and programming, delivered via the company's platform and managed through platform management software.

products.name: Implementation and Professional Development Services
products.description: Training and implementation services for educators and institutions to ensure effective use of the company's AR/VR educational products, delivered by a network of trainers in the U.S. and by resellers internationally.

products.name: Real Estate Brokerage Franchising
products.description: Franchising of real estate brokerages under the RE/MAX brand, including residential, luxury, and commercial real estate. The company provides franchisees with brand rights, technology platforms, marketing tools, and support, but does not own or operate brokerage offices. Delivery is through a franchise model with recurring fee-based revenue.

products.name: Mortgage Brokerage Franchising
products.description: Franchising of mortgage brokerages in the U.S. under the Motto Mortgage brand. The company provides franchisees with setup guidance, compliance support, technology platforms, and access to wholesale lenders, enabling independent operation of mortgage brokerage businesses. Delivery is through a franchise model with fixed and variable fees.

products.name: Mortgage Loan Processing Services
products.description: Provision of third-party mortgage loan processing services and cloud-based workflow technology to Motto franchisees and other mortgage brokers through the wemlo brand. Services are delivered digitally via a proprietary platform that automates and standardizes loan processing tasks.

products.name: Marketing Technology and Services Platform
products.description: Provision of digital marketing tools, automated campaign management, and analytics to franchisees and agents via the Marketing as a Service (MaaS) platform and BoldTrail technology suite. Delivered as a digital, AI-enabled platform to support real estate and mortgage marketing activities.

products.name: Digital Advertising and Media Services
products.description: Sale of advertising, media, and sponsorship opportunities through flagship websites (remax.com, remax.ca, mottomortgage.com) and the REMAX Media Network. Delivered digitally to generate leads and promote brand awareness for agents and franchisees.

products.name: Ready-to-Drink (RTD) Protein Shakes
products.description: Nutritional beverages formulated with high protein content, produced primarily through third-party contract manufacturing and distributed via retail, club, eCommerce, and specialty channels. These are shelf-stable, packaged in aseptic cartons or bottles, and targeted at everyday and sports nutrition consumers.

products.name: Protein Powders
products.description: Powdered protein supplements, primarily whey-based, manufactured by third parties and sold in tubs or pouches for mixing into beverages or foods. These products are marketed under brands like Premier Protein and Dymatize, and are distributed globally through retail, specialty, and online channels.

products.name: Nutrition Bars and Gels
products.description: Packaged nutrition bars and gels produced at the company-owned plant in Germany and by third-party manufacturers, primarily for the European market. These products are designed for convenient, on-the-go nutrition and are distributed through retail and specialty channels.

products.name: MRI Compatible IV Infusion Pump Systems
products.description: Non-magnetic intravenous infusion pump systems specifically designed and manufactured to safely deliver IV fluids and medications during MRI procedures. These systems include the MRidium 3870 and 3860+ models, proprietary disposable IV tubing sets, non-magnetic IV poles, and optional remote display/control units. Products are physically manufactured, assembled, and tested for use in high magnetic field environments.

products.name: MRI Compatible Patient Vital Signs Monitoring Systems
products.description: Non-magnetic patient monitoring systems designed and manufactured to safely and accurately monitor vital signs (ECG, SpO2, blood pressure, CO2, temperature, anesthetic agents) during MRI procedures. The IRadimed 3880 system is compact, lightweight, and includes wireless monitoring and remote control features for use in high magnetic field environments.

products.name: Ferromagnetic Detection Devices (FMD)
products.description: Ferromagnetic detection devices (such as the IRadimed FMD1 3600 with Remote Alarm Logging Unit) designed and manufactured to detect and log ferrous metal threats approaching MRI scanner rooms, using proprietary TruSense technology. These are physical devices installed in hospitals to enhance MRI safety.

products.name: Disposable IV Tubing Sets and Accessories
products.description: Proprietary single-use, MRI compatible IV tubing sets and related disposable accessories designed for use with IRadimed infusion pump systems. These are manufactured consumables required for each infusion procedure, including standard, syringe adapter, and extension sets.

products.name: Extended Maintenance Agreements and Technical Support Services
products.description: Extended maintenance agreements and technical support services for MRI compatible devices, providing ongoing warranty, repair, and technical assistance to customers. These services are delivered by in-person or remote human labor and are sold as contracts to external customers.

products.name: Large Installment Loans
products.description: Secured, fixed-rate, fixed-term loans ranging from $2,501 to $35,000, typically secured by non-essential household goods and/or a vehicle, originated and serviced through branches, direct mail, and digital channels.

products.name: Small Installment Loans
products.description: Secured, fixed-rate, fixed-term loans ranging from $500 to $2,500, typically secured by non-essential household goods and/or, to a lesser extent, a lien on a vehicle, originated and serviced through branches, direct mail, and digital channels.

products.name: Optional Payment and Collateral Protection Insurance Products
products.description: Optional insurance products sold in connection with loans, including credit life, accident and health, involuntary unemployment, and personal property insurance, underwritten by unaffiliated insurers and reinsured by a captive subsidiary.

products.name: Club Membership Products
products.description: Optional club membership products administered by a third-party provider, offering services such as emergency towing, roadside assistance, locksmith service, travel discounts, and limited legal services, sold to loan customers in select states.

products.name: Advanced Deposition Materials
products.description: Ultra-pure liquid and solid precursors, including organometallic and inorganic precursors, for deposition of metals and dielectrics in semiconductor manufacturing. Produced via chemical synthesis, purification, and delivered in specialized containers for use in CVD and ALD processes.

products.name: CMP Solutions (Slurries and Pads)
products.description: Chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) slurries and polishing pads for planarizing and polishing semiconductor wafers, including advanced materials like tungsten, copper, dielectrics, and emerging metals. Manufactured through chemical formulation and polymer processing, delivered as consumables for wafer fabrication.

products.name: Formulated Cleaning and Etch Chemistries
products.description: Specialty chemical formulations for cleaning and etching semiconductor wafers, including post-etch residue removal, resist removal, and post-CMP cleans. Produced via chemical synthesis and blending, delivered as high-purity liquids for use in wet process tools.

products.name: Specialty Gases for Ion Implantation
products.description: Specialty gases and gas mixtures for ion implantation processes in semiconductor manufacturing, delivered via proprietary Safe Delivery Source (SDS®) and Vacuum Actuated Cylinder (VAC®) systems to ensure safe, efficient, and pure gas delivery.

products.name: Specialty Coatings and Electrostatic Chucks
products.description: High-performance specialty coatings and electrostatic chucks for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, providing erosion resistance, contamination prevention, and critical component performance. Produced via advanced materials processing and coating technologies.

products.name: Wafer and Reticle Transport Solutions
products.description: High-purity carriers, pods, and shipping boxes (e.g., FOUPs, SMIF pods, EUV reticle pods) for safe and contamination-free transport and storage of semiconductor wafers and reticles during manufacturing and shipping. Manufactured from engineered polymers in cleanroom environments.

products.name: Liquid Filtration and Purification Products
products.description: Filtration and purification systems for removing contaminants from process liquids and chemicals used in semiconductor manufacturing, including point-of-use and bulk chemical filtration. Produced using advanced membrane and filter technologies, installed in fabs and chemical plants.

products.name: Gas Filtration and Purification Products
products.description: Filtration and purification products for removing particulate and molecular contaminants from process gases in semiconductor manufacturing, including facility-wide and point-of-use gas purifiers and filters. Manufactured using advanced adsorbent and membrane technologies.

products.name: Fluid Management and Chemical Handling Solutions
products.description: High-purity chemical containers, drums, flexible packaging, valves, fittings, tubing, and dispense systems for safe storage, transport, and delivery of ultra-pure chemicals in semiconductor fabs. Produced via polymer processing and precision engineering, supporting bulk and point-of-use chemical management.

products.name: Process Monitoring and Control Equipment
products.description: Instrumentation and digital systems for monitoring and controlling chemical concentration, particle size, and flow in semiconductor manufacturing processes, ensuring process consistency and yield. Includes on-tool analyzers and digital flow control technologies.

products.name: Advanced Cleaning Materials for Wafer and Package Testing
products.description: Consumable cleaning products for advanced probe cards and test sockets, as well as polymer products for improving tool uptime and reducing costs in wafer and package testing. Manufactured via materials science and polymer processing.

products.name: Advanced Materials for Adjacent Markets
products.description: Specialty graphite products, chemicals, and materials for non-semiconductor markets such as aerospace, medical devices, glass manufacturing, and electrical discharge machining. Produced using advanced materials processing and chemical synthesis.

products.name: Industrial Coating Systems
products.description: Automated and manual systems for dispensing, applying, and curing coatings, sealants, and adhesives, including powder and liquid finishing, used in manufacturing and finishing operations. These systems require physical manufacturing and are delivered as equipment and integrated solutions.

products.name: Nonwovens Dispensing and Laminating Systems
products.description: Systems for dispensing, coating, and laminating adhesives, lotions, liquids, and fibers onto disposable and continuous roll goods, primarily for hygiene and medical products. These are manufactured equipment solutions for high-volume production lines.

products.name: Packaging Adhesive Dispensing Systems
products.description: Automated adhesive dispensing systems for rigid packaged goods industries, used in food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and consumer goods packaging. These are manufactured equipment solutions integrated into customer production lines.

products.name: Polymer Processing Equipment
products.description: Components and systems for processing thermoplastic and biopolymer materials in extrusion, injection molding, compounding, polymerization, and recycling. These are manufactured hardware products for industrial and consumer goods production.

products.name: Precision Agriculture Spraying Solutions
products.description: Precision spraying solutions including fluid components (nozzles, pumps, filters), smart components for flow control, and control systems with software for agricultural applications. These combine manufactured hardware with digital controls and software.

products.name: Product Assembly Dispensing and Laminating Systems
products.description: Systems for dispensing, coating, and laminating adhesives and materials in the assembly of plastic, metal, wood, paper, and roll goods for various manufacturing applications. Delivered as manufactured equipment for integration into production lines.

products.name: Engineered Fluid Dispensing Solutions
products.description: Precision manual and semi-automated dispensers, including single-use plastic syringes, cartridges, tips, and fluid connection components, used in medical and industrial production processes. These are manufactured components and devices.

products.name: Medical Interventional Device Solutions
products.description: Engineered components and delivery systems for minimally invasive surgical procedures, including medical tubing, balloons, balloon inflators, nitinol devices, cannula, and biomaterial delivery systems. These are manufactured medical devices for OEMs and healthcare providers.

products.name: Medical Fluid Components
products.description: Proprietary single-use plastic components for medical fluid management, including drug delivery and needle-free infusion valves, fluid transfer components, and related items. These are manufactured consumables for medical applications.

products.name: Surgical Solutions
products.description: Microplegia myocardial protection devices and related consumables used in cardiac surgical procedures. These are specialized manufactured medical devices for surgical applications.

products.name: Electronics Dispense and Surface Treatment Systems
products.description: Automated dispensing systems for high-speed, precise application of fluids and gas plasma treatment systems for cleaning and conditioning surfaces in electronics manufacturing. These are manufactured equipment solutions for semiconductor and electronics production lines.

products.name: Test, Inspection, and Measurement Systems
products.description: Destructive and non-destructive testing technologies, including bond testers, automated optical, acoustic microscopy, x-ray inspection, and precision measurement sensors and analyzers, used to ensure quality in semiconductor, electronics, and industrial manufacturing. These are manufactured systems often integrated with proprietary software.

products.name: Building Products
products.description: Manufactured exterior and interior building products including siding, trim, mouldings, stone veneer, roofing, windows, and outdoor living products, primarily made from PVC and other polymers, delivered through physical manufacturing at 53 facilities and distributed via owned and leased centers.

products.name: PVC Pipe, Specialty Pipe, and Fittings
products.description: Manufacture and sale of PVC pipe (standard and specialty) and fittings for water, sewer, electrical, industrial, and other infrastructure applications, produced at dedicated facilities and distributed to contractors and distributors.

products.name: Polymer Compounds
products.description: Production of custom-blended PVC and other polymer compounds for use in building materials, automotive, healthcare, wire and cable, and consumer goods, manufactured at 11 global facilities and sold to fabricators and OEMs.

products.name: Recycled Polymer Products
products.description: Manufacture of post-industrial recycled PVC, PE, and TPE compounds and finished products such as landscape edging, matting, dock edging, and masonry control joints, using recycled materials and sold to consumer and professional markets.

products.name: Ethylene and Ethylene Co-Products
products.description: Production and sale of ethylene and co-products (chemical grade propylene, crude butadiene, pyrolysis gasoline, hydrogen) via large-scale petrochemical plants, with most ethylene used internally and co-products sold to external customers.

products.name: Chlor-Alkali (Chlorine and Caustic Soda)
products.description: Production of chlorine and caustic soda (chlor-alkali) via electrochemical processes at multiple global plants, with products sold to external customers for use in pulp and paper, chemicals, water treatment, and other industries.

products.name: Vinyl Chloride Monomer (VCM) and Ethylene Dichloride (EDC)
products.description: Production and sale of VCM and EDC, key intermediates in the PVC production chain, manufactured at integrated facilities with excess not used internally sold to external customers.

products.name: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Resins
products.description: Manufacture and sale of commodity and specialty PVC resins for use in construction, packaging, automotive, and medical applications, produced at global facilities and sold to downstream fabricators and international markets.

products.name: Polyethylene (PE) Resins
products.description: Production and sale of low-density, linear low-density, and high-density polyethylene resins in pellet form for use in packaging films, bags, containers, and molded products, manufactured at North American plants and sold to external customers.

products.name: Chlorinated Derivative Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of chlorinated chemicals such as ethyl chloride, perchloroethylene, trichloroethylene, solvents, calcium hypochlorite, and hydrochloric acid, produced at dedicated facilities and sold for use in water treatment, refrigerants, and chemical production.

products.name: Epoxy Resins and Intermediates
products.description: Production and sale of epoxy specialty resins, base epoxy resins, and intermediates (including bisphenol-A), manufactured at global facilities and used in coatings, adhesives, construction, automotive, wind energy, and electronics industries.

products.name: Precision and Specialty Controlled Motion Components and Systems
products.description: Custom-engineered electro-magnetic, mechanical, and electronic motion components and integrated systems, including motors, actuators, and mechatronic assemblies, manufactured in global facilities and delivered to OEMs and end customers across industrial, vehicle, medical, and aerospace & defense markets.

products.name: Motion Control Electronics and Software
products.description: Digital and analog motion controllers, servo control systems, digital servo amplifiers and drives, and related software, designed and produced for integration with motion hardware to provide precise control and automation in customer applications.

products.name: Power Quality and Filtering Solutions
products.description: Active (electronic) and passive (magnetic) filters and power quality products, manufactured for industrial and infrastructure customers to address harmonic distortion and power issues caused by variable frequency drives and other equipment.

products.name: Industrial Communication and Safety Modules
products.description: Universal industrial communications gateways and safety-rated input/output modules, designed and produced for integration into factory automation and industrial equipment to enable connectivity and safety compliance.

products.name: Precision Positioning and Nano-Motion Systems
products.description: Nano precision positioning systems and related motion platforms, engineered and assembled for applications requiring ultra-high accuracy, such as semiconductor, photonics, and medical device manufacturing.

products.name: Electrical Transformers
products.description: Custom and standard electrical transformers, designed and manufactured for industrial automation, defense, alternative power generation, and energy markets, including electric utilities and renewable energy.

products.name: Integrated Controlled Motion Solutions and System Integration Services
products.description: Turn-key integration of Allient's motion, control, and power products into custom system solutions, including design, assembly, testing, and support, delivered through Solution Centers for OEM and end-user applications.

products.name: FREEDOM Infusion System
products.description: A mechanical, portable, maintenance-free subcutaneous infusion system comprising the FREEDOM60 Syringe Driver, FreedomEdge Syringe Driver, HIgH-Flo Subcutaneous Safety Needle Sets, and Precision Flow Rate Tubing, used for self-administration or healthcare provider administration of large-volume drugs at home or in infusion centers. The system is manufactured at the company's facility and is FDA-cleared for multiple drug indications.

products.name: Pharma Services and Clinical Trials Support
products.description: Non-recurring engineering services, product innovation, testing, and regulatory registration services provided to biopharmaceutical companies to customize and ready the FREEDOM System for use in clinical trials and commercial drug launches. Delivered through partnerships with drug developers during pre-clinical and clinical phases.

products.name: Rilparencel Autologous Cell Therapy
products.description: A first-in-class, autologous cell therapy manufactured from a patient's own kidney biopsy tissue, expanded and selected for renal cells (SRC), formulated into a cryopreserved product, and delivered via minimally invasive percutaneous injection into the patient's kidneys to preserve kidney function in patients with advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD) and diabetes. The product requires specialized manufacturing facilities compliant with cGMP and is administered as an outpatient procedure.

products.name: Cloud Object Storage Services
products.description: High-performance, secure, and reliable object storage delivered via the Backblaze Storage Cloud platform, designed for data-intensive workloads such as AI, media, backup, and multi-cloud environments. Delivered as Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) and accessible through APIs, SDKs, web interface, and third-party integrations.

products.name: Computer Backup Services
products.description: Automated, continuous backup of laptops, desktops, and external hard drives for individuals and businesses, delivered as a subscription-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) with unlimited file size and flat-rate pricing. Includes a lightweight agent for local file monitoring and cloud backup.

products.name: White-Label Cloud Storage Integration
products.description: Cloud storage infrastructure offered to third-party organizations for integration into their own products and services under their own brand, enabling partners to deliver storage solutions directly to their customers via the Powered by Backblaze program.

products.name: Parking Facility Services
products.description: Provision of paid parking spaces in owned parking lots, garages, and structures, delivered through physical real estate assets and managed via transient (hourly/daily) and contract (monthly) arrangements. Services are operated in collaboration with third-party operators and require ongoing asset management and rate optimization.

products.name: Ancillary Parking Facility Services
products.description: Provision of additional services at parking facilities, such as EV charging, solar energy, rideshare staging, autonomous vehicle support, fleet management, wireless technology hosting, storage, and basic vehicle services (cleaning, repairs, valet), leveraging physical infrastructure and technology partnerships.

products.name: Commercial Space Leasing
products.description: Leasing of commercial real estate space adjacent to parking facilities, delivered through ownership and rental of approximately 0.2 million square feet of commercial property.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of crude oil produced from onshore wells in the Delaware Basin, primarily in Texas. This involves physical drilling, well operation, and delivery of oil to purchasers such as refiners and marketers.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas from operated wells, including gathering, processing, and delivery to pipeline companies and marketers. Production is managed through drilling, completion, and operation of wells, with processing handled by third-party midstream providers.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) such as ethane, propane, and butane, separated from produced natural gas at processing facilities. Involves well operation and third-party processing before sale to marketers.

products.name: PIKTOR (Multi-Node Inhibitor of PI3K/AKT/mTOR Pathway)
products.description: An investigational, proprietary, all-oral combination therapy (serabelisib and sapanisertib) designed to inhibit multiple nodes of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway for the treatment of solid tumors, including advanced endometrial and HR+/HER2- breast cancer. Manufactured as an oral drug product and delivered via clinical trials, with plans for commercial distribution upon approval.

products.name: NEAAR (Non Essential Amino Acid Restriction) Program
products.description: A preclinical regimen that restricts patient intake of specific non-essential amino acids to suppress tumor growth and increase sensitivity to cancer therapies. Delivered as a dietary intervention, potentially in combination with other therapies, based on metabolic disease expertise.

products.name: IEM (Inborn Errors of Metabolism) Program
products.description: A preclinical program aimed at improving treatment for Type I Tyrosinemia, a rare inherited metabolic disease, by developing a therapy that eliminates off-target effects of current standard of care drugs. Delivered as a pharmaceutical product, based on preclinical models.

products.name: Solnerstotug (SNS-101) and Conditionally Active Antibody Programs
products.description: A portfolio of conditionally active monoclonal antibody therapeutics targeting immune checkpoints (e.g., VISTA, VSIG4, CD39, CD28) for cancer treatment. Includes solnerstotug in Phase 1/2 trials and several preclinical-stage antibodies, produced via biologic manufacturing and delivered as injectable therapeutics.

products.name: Water Analytics Solutions
products.description: Proprietary precision instrumentation, digital solutions, and related consumables for measuring and analyzing water quality, delivered through physical devices, software, and recurring consumables to municipal, industrial, and research customers.

products.name: Water Treatment Solutions
products.description: Advanced water treatment technologies, including chemical treatment plans, dosing protocols, UV and membrane filtration systems, and related services, physically installed and maintained for municipal, industrial, and commercial water purification and reuse.

products.name: Marking and Coding Solutions
products.description: Inline printing, marking, and coding systems and related consumables for product and packaging identification, authenticity, and traceability, delivered via physical equipment and consumables to consumer, pharmaceutical, and industrial sectors.

products.name: Packaging and Color Management Solutions
products.description: Packaging design software, imaging systems, color measurement instruments, and color standards for packaging development, quality control, and brand consistency, delivered as software, hardware, and digital standards to CPG, food, and industrial customers.

products.name: Regulatory Compliance and Workflow Software
products.description: Cloud-based and on-premise software solutions for digital asset management, marketing resource management, product information management, and regulatory compliance, delivered as SaaS or licensed software to support packaging, food safety, and traceability.

products.name: Consumables and Services for Installed Base
products.description: Recurring sales of consumables (chemical reagents, inks, process chemicals), spare parts, and maintenance and inspection services supporting the installed base of water and product quality equipment, delivered physically and through service teams.

products.name: Communications Site Leasing
products.description: Leasing of space on communications sites (primarily towers) to wireless service providers, broadcasters, and other tenants. This involves physical real estate assets, long-term leases, and requires ongoing site maintenance and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Data Center Leasing
products.description: Leasing of space and related services in specialized, secure data center facilities to enterprises, network operators, cloud providers, and service providers. This requires physical infrastructure, power, cooling, and network connectivity, and is delivered through owned and operated facilities.

products.name: Distributed Antenna System (DAS) and Managed Network Solutions
products.description: Provision and operation of distributed antenna system (DAS) networks and managed network solutions, including in-building and outdoor wireless coverage infrastructure. This involves designing, building, and operating shared wireless infrastructure, often in locations where traditional towers are not viable.

products.name: Telecommunications Fiber Leasing
products.description: Leasing of fiber and related telecommunications infrastructure assets to communications and internet service providers and third-party operators, primarily in select international markets. This involves physical fiber networks and associated property interests.

products.name: Property Interests Leasing and Site Management
products.description: Leasing of land and property interests under carrier or third-party communications sites, and management of rooftop and tower sites for property owners. This includes recurring cash flow from land and rooftop leases and site management services.

products.name: Shared Power Solutions and Backup Power Services
products.description: Provision of shared backup power generators, solar panels, and electricity storage solutions to tower tenants, primarily in the U.S. and Africa. This involves physical infrastructure and ongoing maintenance to ensure reliable power supply.

products.name: Tower-Related Services (Site Application, Zoning, Structural Analysis, Construction Management)
products.description: Provision of tower-related services in the U.S., including site application, zoning and permitting, structural and mount analyses, construction management, and program management for network deployment. These are delivered through in-person professional services and engineering teams.

products.name: Electronic Components and Assemblies
products.description: Designs, engineers, and manufactures sensing and switching technologies, instrument transformers, current sensors, custom wound transformers, inductors, and value-added assemblies for OEMs in various industries. Production involves vertically integrated manufacturing across global facilities.

products.name: Metal-Formed Components and Assemblies
products.description: Provides innovative, metal-formed components and assemblies for space, aviation, defense, energy, and industrial markets, using advanced forming technologies and vertically integrated manufacturing processes. Products include fuel tanks, nacelle lipskins, missile nose cones, and turbine assemblies.

products.name: Specialty Temperature-Controlled Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures specialty refrigerators, freezers, cryogenic storage tanks, ultra low temperature freezers, and environmental chambers for medical, scientific, pharmaceutical, biotech, and industrial markets. Products are assembled in dedicated U.S. facilities and meet stringent regulatory requirements.

products.name: Custom Mold Texturing and Engraving Services
products.description: Provides custom textures and surface finishes on tooling using laser and chemical engraving, as well as soft trim tooling and nickel shell molds. Services include design, prototyping, engraving, finishing, and repair for automotive, consumer goods, and industrial customers.

products.name: Food Merchandising Display Cases
products.description: Designs and manufactures refrigerated, heated, and dry merchandising display cases for bakery, deli, confectionary, and packaged food products, serving retail and food service establishments. Products are customized to customer requirements and produced in U.S. and China facilities.

products.name: Engineered Hydraulic Cylinders
products.description: Designs and manufactures single and double acting telescopic and piston rod hydraulic cylinders for construction, refuse, mining, oil and gas, and material handling vehicles. Products are engineered to customer specifications and produced in global facilities.

products.name: Telomir-1 Small-Molecule Therapeutic
products.description: A novel, orally administered small-molecule drug candidate designed to modulate intracellular metal balance and address upstream biological drivers of aging and age-related diseases. Telomir-1 is produced through chemical synthesis and is being developed for multiple therapeutic indications, including Wilson’s disease, Type 2 diabetes, oncology, age-related macular degeneration, progeria, and age-reversal/longevity. Delivery is via oral administration, and the product requires regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Animation Production Services
products.description: Production of original and third-party commissioned animated content, including television episodes, movies, and feature films, primarily through Mainframe Studios. Delivered via a combination of in-house production, strategic outsourcing, and technology integration for efficiency and scalability.

products.name: Content Licensing and Distribution
products.description: Licensing and distribution of owned and third-party animated films and television programs to broadcasters, streaming platforms, and digital channels globally. Includes both direct licensing and placement of branded channels across AVOD, SVOD, FAST, and linear platforms.

products.name: Owned and Operated Streaming Platforms
products.description: Operation of proprietary streaming services and channels (Kartoon Channel!, Kartoon Channel! Worldwide, Channel Frederator Network, Ameba TV) delivering curated family-friendly and educational animated content via ad-supported and subscription-based models across multiple digital and smart TV platforms.

products.name: Consumer Products Licensing and Merchandising
products.description: Licensing of intellectual property for use in consumer products such as toys, apparel, home goods, publishing, and collectibles, produced and distributed by third-party manufacturers and retailers. Includes both digital and physical merchandise programs tied to animated franchises.

products.name: Media and Marketing Agency Services
products.description: Provision of media advisory, advertising, and marketing services to external clients in the toy, gaming, and consumer products industries, including media planning, buying, influencer marketing, and campaign development, primarily through Beacon Media Group.

products.name: Ampligen (rintatolimod) Immuno-Oncology Therapies
products.description: Ampligen is a double-stranded RNA molecule developed and manufactured by AIM ImmunoTech for use as an immuno-oncology therapeutic, primarily for late-stage pancreatic cancer and other solid tumors. It is administered intravenously or intraperitoneally, often in combination with checkpoint inhibitors or chemotherapy, and is produced through specialized nucleic acid synthesis and fill-finish processes at contract manufacturing organizations.

products.name: Ampligen (rintatolimod) Antiviral Therapies
products.description: Ampligen is developed as a broad-spectrum antiviral therapeutic and prophylactic, targeting diseases such as COVID-19, Ebola, and influenza. It is administered intravenously or intranasally and is produced using nucleic acid synthesis and pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. Clinical and preclinical studies support its use against various viral infections, including as a vaccine adjuvant.

products.name: Ampligen (rintatolimod) for Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) and Post-COVID Conditions
products.description: Ampligen is approved in Argentina and provided under expanded access programs in other regions for the treatment of severe Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) and Post-COVID fatigue. It is administered intravenously and manufactured through nucleic acid synthesis and fill-finish processes, with ongoing clinical trials and expanded access protocols supporting its use.

products.name: Alferon N Injection (Interferon alfa)
products.description: Alferon N Injection is a natural-source, multi-species alpha interferon product produced from human white blood cells, approved for the intralesional treatment of refractory or recurring external genital warts in the United States and Argentina, and for patients intolerant to recombinant interferons in Argentina. Manufacturing involves purification from human leukocytes, but commercial production is currently on hold.

products.name: Home Furniture
products.description: Heirloom-quality, artisan-crafted furniture for all rooms of the home, including bedroom, dining room, living room, and home office. Products are designed in-house, manufactured domestically and globally, and sold through showrooms and eCommerce.

products.name: Outdoor Furniture and Accessories
products.description: Premium outdoor furniture and accessories, including dining tables, chairs, chaises, lighting, textiles, décor, umbrellas, and fire pits, sourced globally and sold through omni-channel retail.

products.name: Bath Furnishings and Accessories
products.description: Bath-related products such as vanities, storage pieces, faucets, hardware, and Turkish bath towels, curated and sourced from global vendors for residential use.

products.name: Lighting Fixtures
products.description: Distinctive lighting products including chandeliers, pendants, table and floor lamps, and sconces, designed and curated for residential interiors and exteriors.

products.name: Textiles
products.description: Handcrafted indoor and outdoor textiles such as rugs, bed linens, pillows, and throws, sourced from artisans and global vendors.

products.name: Home Décor and Accessories
products.description: A curated selection of decorative accessories including wall art, mirrors, vases, candles, and other items to complement home interiors, sourced globally.

products.name: Interior Design Services
products.description: Complimentary interior design services provided by trained consultants, offering personalized support for full-room and whole-home projects, available in showrooms, online, and in clients' residences.

products.name: Trade and Professional Services
products.description: Dedicated program for interior designers and trade professionals, providing access to product assortment, design resources, customization, and service offerings for project-based demand.

products.name: Quantum Computing Hardware and Systems
products.description: Specialized quantum computers and complete quantum computing systems, based on trapped ion technology, sold as physical hardware for on-premises or remote use. These systems are manufactured and delivered as physical products requiring advanced engineering and precision manufacturing.

products.name: Quantum Computing-as-a-Service (QCaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based access to IonQ's quantum computers, delivered via major cloud platforms and IonQ's own cloud service, enabling customers to run quantum algorithms remotely without owning hardware. This is a digital service leveraging IonQ's proprietary hardware infrastructure.

products.name: Quantum Networking Products and Services
products.description: Hardware and services enabling the connection of quantum and classical computers, including devices for transmitting quantum information over satellite and fiber optic infrastructure. These products require specialized photonic and networking hardware and are delivered as both physical devices and managed services.

products.name: Quantum Sensing Devices and Services
products.description: Quantum sensing devices, including atomic clocks and related systems, providing advanced timekeeping, synchronization, orientation, and navigation capabilities. These are physical devices deployed in various environments and may be bundled with related services.

products.name: Quantum Security Products and Services
products.description: Quantum-safe encryption hardware and software leveraging quantum mechanics for secure data transmission and storage. Delivered as both physical devices and digital solutions, these products are designed to protect customer data assets.

products.name: Professional and Algorithm Development Services
products.description: Consulting and professional services to assist customers in developing, customizing, and applying quantum computing, networking, sensing, and security solutions to their business challenges. Delivered by expert personnel, these services include algorithm development and integration support.

products.name: Satellite-Based Data-as-a-Service (SAR Imaging)
products.description: Satellite-based synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging data delivered as a subscription or on-demand service. This product leverages a constellation of satellites to provide geospatial data to customers, primarily as a digital service.

products.name: Crude Oil and Natural Gas Exploration and Production
products.description: ExxonMobil explores for and produces crude oil and natural gas globally, involving large-scale physical extraction, drilling, and field operations.

products.name: Petroleum Products
products.description: Manufacture, trade, transport, and sale of refined petroleum products such as gasoline, diesel, and lubricants, requiring extensive refining infrastructure and global logistics.

products.name: Petrochemicals
products.description: Production and sale of petrochemical products used as feedstocks for plastics and other industrial applications, involving large-scale chemical manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Specialty Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of a wide variety of specialty chemical and petroleum-based products, produced in specialized facilities for niche industrial uses.

products.name: Lower-Emission Fuels
products.description: Development and sale of lower-emission fuels, leveraging advanced refining and chemical processes to reduce carbon intensity for customers.

products.name: Carbon Capture and Storage Services
products.description: Provision of carbon capture and storage solutions for industrial customers, involving regulated infrastructure and advanced engineering to reduce emissions.

products.name: Hydrogen and Ammonia
products.description: Production and sale of hydrogen and ammonia as alternative energy carriers and industrial feedstocks, requiring specialized chemical manufacturing and distribution systems.

products.name: Proxxima Resin Systems and Carbon Materials
products.description: Development and sale of advanced resin systems (Proxxima) and carbon materials for industrial and manufacturing applications, produced in specialized facilities.

products.name: Low-Carbon Data Centers
products.description: Development and provision of low-carbon data center solutions, leveraging energy expertise to reduce emissions in digital infrastructure.

products.name: Lithium
products.description: Production and sale of lithium, likely for use in batteries and energy storage, involving extraction and chemical processing operations.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Origination and Servicing
products.description: Origination of residential mortgage loans through multiple channels (direct to consumer, retail, wholesale, correspondent) and servicing of performing and delinquent loans, including subservicing for third-party clients. Requires significant human labor, regulated infrastructure, and capital markets funding.

products.name: Residential Transitional Lending
products.description: Short-term business-purpose mortgage loans for construction, renovation, bridge, and build-to-rent projects, originated and managed through Genesis. Involves underwriting, property inspections, and is funded via warehouse credit facilities and securitizations.

products.name: Asset Management Services
products.description: Investment management and advisory services across alternative strategies (private credit, opportunistic credit, fund liquidity, real estate, CLOs) for institutional and other investors, generating fee-based and incentive income. Delivered via managed funds, accounts, and permanent capital vehicles, requiring financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Single-Family Rental (SFR) Property Leasing and Management
products.description: Acquisition, renovation, leasing, and management of single-family residential properties, including build-to-rent communities, for rental income. Requires physical property management, renovation, and ongoing maintenance.

products.name: Title, Appraisal, and Property Preservation Services
products.description: Provision of title insurance, settlement, appraisal valuation, and property preservation/maintenance services to mortgage and real estate sectors, delivered through specialized subsidiaries. Requires licensed professionals and compliance with real estate regulations.

products.name: Consumer Loan Investment and Management
products.description: Acquisition and management of portfolios of unsecured consumer loans, purchased from third parties and managed for investment income. Involves financial capital, credit analysis, and securitization expertise.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Investment and Management
products.description: Ownership, operation, and asset management of commercial real estate properties (notably Class A office assets), including direct lending and joint ventures. Requires significant capital, property management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Non-Agency Securities and RMBS Investment
products.description: Investment in non-Agency residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS) and private-label securitizations, including risk retention bonds. Requires financial capital, structured finance expertise, and capital markets access.

products.name: Excess Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs) Investment
products.description: Acquisition and management of Excess MSRs, representing the right to receive servicing cash flows above the base fee. Involves financial structuring and partnership with primary servicers.

products.name: Servicer Advance Investments
products.description: Investment in the rights to reimbursement of funds advanced by mortgage servicers to cover delinquent payments and property expenses. Requires capital and expertise in mortgage servicing and securitization.

products.name: Collateralized Loan Obligation (CLO) Management and Investment
products.description: Management of CLO vehicles and investment in CLO securities, including acting as collateral manager and earning management and incentive fees. Requires structured finance expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Annuity Insurance Products
products.description: Issuance of annuity insurance products through regulated insurance subsidiaries, requiring insurance licensing, capital reserves, and compliance with insurance regulations.
